text:
maria: Heads-up: nightly smoke against hosted is red on shard-19. Failures hitting auth handshake, streaming disconnects, and tool-call 502s. Can't repro locally. Anyone able to grab a quick triage?

ajay: On it, pinging @kevin and @jen. Do we have the failing logs or a CI link? :eyes:

maria: CI run: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/5789 (shard-19). Main noise is repeated 401 during token exchange then stream tears down. Quick excerpt:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:05Z auth-proxy WARN kid mismatch, token.kid=xyz expected=abc
2026-03-16T03:12:05Z client-stream ERROR EOF after 2s, proto=websocket code=1006
2026-03-16T03:12:06Z toolcall ERROR upstream 502 during tool invocation
```

deploy-bot: nightly-smoke finished 2623456760 - status: partial-fail (shard-19) :rotating_light:

ci-bot: rerun requested (shard-19) by ajay at 2623456798. Parallel shards queued x4.

kevin: hmm, we rotated a JWK set yesterday for internal keyring. I thought we toggled the compatibility flag... checking commit history.

jen: We only rolled the new kid to staging in the morning, not prod. But the auth-proxy image rolled with the new env var in the same deploy that hit prod last night (PR #4128).

ajay: Can we bisect between deploys: deploy-2026-03-15T22:00 and deploy-2026-03-16T02:00? If the smoke goes green on rerun that's helpful. If it stays red, we collect packet/trace.

maria: Starting parallel reruns now. If you want to reproduce locally, minimal curl to hit the handshake: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Request-ID: smoke-test-1" https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/stream-start
# logs show 401 + response header: X-KID: xyz (expected abc)
```

kevin: If it's kid mismatch that's likely a JWKS caching/propagation problem between auth-proxy and token issuer. I'll check cache TTLs and any recent nginx reloads. :mag_right:

jen: Also saw intermittent toolcall 502s in the same timeframe. Could be a downstream routing flap. I'll open a quick dashboard filter: prod -> tool-pods -> last 30m.

ajay: If reruns fail, can someone run a targeted bisect? I can coordinate if you give a commit range. Otherwise we escalate to oncall in 30m.

maria: Reruns started (4 shards). If anything shows consistent failure on shard-19 I’ll collect auth-proxy logs, token issuer jwks, and tcpdump. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-integ-triage 

kevin: quick check - I see a config change in PR #4128 that touched AUTH_JWKS_TTL=60 -> 5. That could explain tight window. Marking PR for bisect.

ajay: Good catch. Assigning myself to bisect between builds containing PR #4128. Will update here in 10-15. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: thanks — if anyone sees a green rerun, ping me. Otherwise we regroup in 20. :thumbsup:
